title: Analytic thinking promotes religious disbelief.
central_claims: Analytic-thinking manipulations cause increased religious disbelief, alongside a correlational association between reflection and disbelief.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: The Thinker-image manipulation failed in pooled stage 2: r=-.035, p=.415, N=531; a separate preregistered multisite experiment also found no causal priming effect.

source_manifest.title: Direct replication of Gervais & Norenzayan (2012): No evidence that analytic thinking decreases religious belief
source_manifest.finding: Preregistered multisite N=941 replication reported d=.07 in the opposite direction, 95% CI[-.12,.25], and concluded the original priming finding was not reliable causal evidence.
